annotations.title: Helper: show something on the call page

description: For a helper session that is not in the call: puts a card on the person's call page (never spoken), shown with the sender 'Helper <label>: <helper_name>'. kind: text (default), code, link (exactly one http(s) URL) or image (`image` = SVG text or base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP, never a URL). Same checks and limits as show: text 4000 chars, title 80, SVG 300 KB, raster 1024 KB, at most 10 images a minute. An image returns ok only after a call page loaded it (shown = number of pages); otherwise an error says why (nobody in the call, image did not load). Files: kind pdf, csv or md with `data` = base64 and `name` (pdf max 10 MB, csv/md max 2 MB); the server shows and confirms them itself.

credential.description: Helper credential `token` from helper_credential or POST /api/helper/credential.
credential.title: Credential

data.description: kind pdf, csv or md: the file as base64.
data.title: Data

helper_name.description: Name of this helper session, 1-40 chars (shown on the call page as `from`).
helper_name.title: Helper Name

image.description: kind image: SVG text or base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP (SVG max 300 KB, raster max 1 MB).
image.title: Image

name.description: kind pdf, csv or md: file name.
name.title: Name

text.description: Card text, max 4000 chars (code: the code; link: the URL).
